notes.title: Exiled Survivors Is Now Free to Play!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

The time has come – Exiled Survivors is now free to play on Steam! 🎉

For those who’ve supported the game from the beginning, your contributions have meant the world to me. You’ve helped shape Exiled Survivors into what it is today, and I can’t thank you enough.

Thank you for being a part of Exiled Survivors. Let’s keep surviving together!

notes.title: Exiled Survivors is Going Free!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

Exciting news – starting next month, Exiled Survivors will be permanently free on Steam! This is my way of saying thank you to everyone who’s supported the game so far. By making it free, I hope to grow our community and welcome new players to join the journey.

Thank you for being a part of Exiled Survivors. Let’s keep surviving together!

notes.title: Available Now: Exiled Survivors is ready for download
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

Get ready to experience the thrill, the challenges, and the triumphs that await in Exiled Survivors. Download the game now and immerse yourself in an epic adventure where your choices define your destiny.

[b]🏆 Newly Added: Achievements![/b]
Test your skills and unlock achievements to showcase your prowess in Exiled Survivors. Can you conquer them all?

Thank you for your support, and may you survive the exile!

notes.title: New Demo Alert! Explore Exiled Survivors - Try Now!
notes.content:
Hey Survivors,

We're thrilled to announce that an updated demo for Exiled Survivors is now live on Steam! 🚀 We've polished up the gaming experience with Quality of Life features, squashed a bunch of bugs, and to spice things up, we've added a [b]brand-new level[/b] for you to conquer.

Your feedback has been invaluable, and we can't wait for you to experience the improvements firsthand. Mark your calendars because Exiled Survivors officially launches on [b]February 20th![/b] 🗓️

See you in the game, Survivors!

notes.title: Experience the relentless thrill of Exiled Survivors!
notes.content:
The playable demo of Exiled Survivors is now available : you can play 3 of the levels of the full game, with a dozen different characters !
All the skills of the game are already available and yours to learn !

Watch the trailer :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rgx_vmc0o8s

See you soon on the forums of the game !
